Package org.apache.commons.collections4.functors

Class MapTransformer<T,R>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.collections4.functors.MapTransformer<T,R>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the input to the function.
R - the type of the result of the function.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Function<T,R>, Transformer<T,R>
public final class MapTransformer<T,R> extends Object implements Transformer<T,R>, Serializable
Transformer implementation that returns the value held in a specified map using the input parameter as a key.
Since:
3.0
